limitations: Internal engineering review, not independent expert certification.
Original synthetic topographies, not measured material data.
An ideal point sampler is used; no tip convolution, haptic sensation, friction prediction or standards-compliant filtering is calculated.
3D height is exaggerated 50×; surface mesh is a sampled rendering of the same analytic field.
One profile samples one line; grouping is relative to the chosen comparison set.
